Umów demo, aby zobaczyć, na jakim jest etapie. Czy będzie wymagać instalacji? Podamy szczegóły, gdy funkcja będzie gotowa. Podczas demo powiedz nam, które narzędzia chcesz nagrywać. Gdzie są przechowywane instrukcje? W tej samej bibliotece Flexlore co Twoje wideoinstrukcje SOP, z tymi samymi rolami i przypisaniami.

entries.title: Quiz AI
entries.body: AI przygotowuje krótki quiz do każdego zadania, więc widzisz, kto zrozumiał kroki, a nie tylko kto nacisnął odtwarzanie. Przygotowany na podstawie zadania: Pytania powstają z zatwierdzonych przez Ciebie kroków i instrukcji. Odpowiedzi na telefonie: Krótkie, praktyczne sprawdziany zaraz po wideo. Wyniki według osób i lokalizacji: Zobacz, kto zaliczył i na którym pytaniu ludzie mylą się najczęściej. Czy quiz dowodzi, że ktoś potrafi wykonać zadanie? Quiz pokazuje, kto zrozumiał kroki. Dopuszczenie do pracy na stanowisku pozostaje decyzją przełożonego. Czy mogę edytować pytania? Tak. Każde pytanie jest wersją roboczą, dopóki Twój zespół go nie zatwierdzi. Ile quizów mogę utworzyć? To zależy od planu. Limity znajdziesz na stronie z cennikiem.

entries.title: Automatyczne tłumaczenie (Wkrótce)
entries.body: Jedno wideo, każdy pracownik w swoim języku. Automatyczne tłumaczenie kroków i quizów dla wielojęzycznych zespołów pierwszej linii. Utwórz raz: Nagraj i zatwierdź zadanie w swoim języku. Tłumacz automatycznie: Kroki, instrukcje i quiz są tłumaczone na każdy używany przez Was język. Nauka w swoim języku: Każda osoba widzi zadanie w wybranym przez siebie języku. Czy automatyczne tłumaczenie jest już dostępne? Jest w naszych planach. Sama aplikacja Flexlore jest już dostępna w 8 językach. Jakie języki będą obsługiwane? Podamy listę, gdy funkcja będzie gotowa. Powiedz nam, jakimi językami mówią Twoje zespoły. Czy możemy zachować własne terminy? Zachowanie nazw produktów i firmowych terminów jest częścią planu.

entries.title: QR na stanowisku (Wkrótce)
entries.body: Umieść kod QR na maszynie lub stanowisku. Po zeskanowaniu otwiera się właściwe zadanie z krokami, bez szukania. Wydrukuj kod: Każde zadanie ma własny kod QR, który umieszczasz tam, gdzie wykonuje się pracę. Zeskanuj telefonem: Zadanie otwiera się od razu na krokach. Aktualizuj raz: Zmień zadanie, a ten sam kod pokaże nową wersję. Czy dostęp przez QR jest już dostępny? Jest w naszych planach. Umów demo, aby zobaczyć, na jakim jest etapie. Czy po aktualizacji potrzebuję nowych kodów? W planie ten sam kod zawsze otwiera najnowszą wersję zadania. Kto może otworzyć kod? Dostęp będzie zależał od tych samych ról i lokalizacji co w pozostałej części Flexlore.

entries.title: Powiadomienia (Wkrótce)
entries.body: Powiadamiaj właściwe osoby, gdy zadanie zostanie przypisane, zbliża się termin lub zostało zaktualizowane, i śledź ukończenie po zmianie. Zmień zadanie: Opublikuj nową wersję albo przypisz nowe zadanie. Powiadomienie trafia do właściwych osób: Wiadomość dostają tylko role i lokalizacje, których dotyczy. Ukończenie jest śledzone: Zobacz, kto obejrzał i zaliczył zaktualizowane zadanie. Czy powiadomienia są już dostępne? Są w naszych planach. Umów demo, aby zobaczyć, na jakim są etapie. Kto otrzymuje powiadomienie? Tylko osoby, których rola i lokalizacja są objęte zadaniem. Czy kierownicy mogą wysyłać ogłoszenia? Ogłoszenia do zespołów i lokalizacji są częścią planu.

entries.title: Uprawnienia i przestrzenie robocze
entries.body: Role, uprawnienia i przestrzenie robocze dla zespołów w wielu lokalizacjach. Każdy widzi tylko zadania przeznaczone dla swojej roli i lokalizacji. Utwórz przestrzenie robocze: Po jednej dla każdej lokalizacji, zespołu lub działu. Przypisz role: Administratorzy, edytorzy i pracownicy, każdy z własnymi uprawnieniami. Udostępniaj według roli i lokalizacji: Zadania trafiają tylko do osób, dla których są przeznaczone. Ile przestrzeni roboczych możemy mieć? To zależy od planu. Limity znajdziesz na stronie z cennikiem. Czy ktoś może pracować w kilku lokalizacjach? Tak. Dostęp ustawia się według roli i lokalizacji, więc jedna osoba może należeć do więcej niż jednej. Kto decyduje, kto co widzi? Twoi administratorzy. Kierownicy decydują, do których ról i lokalizacji trafia każde zadanie.

entries.title: Panel webowy (Wkrótce)
entries.body: Panel webowy dla kierowników: buduj bibliotekę, przypisuj zadania i śledź ukończenie według osób i lokalizacji. entries.title: Restaurants
entries.body: Same plate. Every shift. Your head chef knows exactly how the line should open, how the walk-in is checked and how a plate leaves the pass. Flexlore puts that knowledge on every phone in the kitchen. The recipe card is not the recipe. Opening checklist: Fridge and walk-in temperatures logged, Hand-wash station stocked, Mise en place by station, Fryer oil checked and filtered. Hygiene steps from your HACCP plan: Colour-coded boards by product, Probe, clean, sanitise, record, Cooling: label, date, rotate, Allergen separation at the pass. Plating a signature dish: Warm plate, wiped rim, Base, protein, garnish in order, Sauce weight, not by eye, Photo check against the standard. Closing down: Label and date everything stored, Degrease and sanitise surfaces, Floor, drains, bins, Final temperature log. Ready for station: grill, cold, pass.

entries.title: Manufacturing
entries.body: Changeover, without the guesswork. The fastest changeover on your floor lives in one operator's hands. Film it once, and every shift runs it the same way. Work instructions that nobody opens. Machine changeover: Isolate and lock out, Remove and stage the previous tooling, Fit, align and torque new tooling, First-off part checked and signed. Daily start-up: Guards and e-stops checked, Lubrication points, Air and pressure readings, Warm-up cycle. Quality check at station: Gauge zeroed, Measure the critical dimensions, Visual defects by reference photo, Record and flag out-of-spec. 5S end of shift: Sort and return tools to shadow board, Clean chips and spills, Restock consumables, Handover note for next shift. Cleared for: press 2, line B changeover.

entries.title: Hotels
entries.body: Every room, turned the same way. Guests notice the details your best housekeeper never misses. Flexlore turns those details into a standard every new team member can follow. Seasonal teams, every season. Housekeeping room turn: Strip, ventilate, check for left items, Bathroom top to bottom, Bed made to the house standard, Amenities placed by reference photo. Front desk check-in: Greeting and ID, Room features and Wi-Fi, Breakfast and checkout times, Escalation for special requests. Breakfast buffet set-up: Hot and cold zones, Allergen labels, Refill rhythm, Closing and storage. Minibar and amenity audit: Count and record, Expiry check, Restock to the plan, Report damages. Ready for: room turn, breakfast.

entries.title: Franchises
entries.body: One brand. Every branch. Your brand standard is only as strong as the newest branch. Flexlore sends the same video standard to every location, and shows you who has learned it. The manual stops at head office. Brand standard for the signature product: Portion and build order, Packaging and presentation, Hold times, Reference photo check. Store opening: Front of house walkthrough, Equipment start-up, Display and signage, Cash and system check. Guest service script: Greeting, Upsell the way the brand does it, Handling a complaint, Goodbye. New menu launch: What changes, Prep and build, Allergen notes, Go-live day checks. Ready branches: compared side by side.

entries.title: Warehouses & logistics
entries.body: Pick it right the first time. Peak season brings new hands to the dock. Flexlore gets them picking, packing and moving safely, the way your site does it. Peak season, every year. Receiving at the dock: Check paperwork against the delivery, Inspect for damage, Scan and label, Put away to location. Pick and pack: Read the pick list, Scan location and item, Pack to the standard, Seal, label, stage. Equipment pre-use check: Visual inspection, Brakes, horn, lights, Forks and chains, Report and tag faults. Safe manual handling: Plan the lift, Stance and grip, Lift with the legs, Team lift above the limit. Ready for: receiving, zone C picking.

Morning bake: Oven pre-heat and steam, Proof check by touch, Score and load, Bake, cool, display. Espresso and milk: Dose, level, tamp, Shot time and taste, Steam and texture, Pour and serve. Daily cleaning: Group heads and wands, Mixer and benches, Display cases, Log and sign. Ready to open: bake, bar.

entries.title: Türkiye'deki müşteriler için veri ve KVKK
entries.body: Verileriniz nerede tutuluyor, kim hangi rolde, Türkiye'den aktarım nasıl yapılıyor ve videoda görünen çalışanlar için neye dikkat etmelisiniz. Kısa ve sade. Verileriniz nerede: Flexlore'daki veriler (hesaplar, iş talimatları, eğitim videoları, quiz sonuçları) Amerika Birleşik Devletleri'nde, Amazon Web Services'in us-east-1 (Kuzey Virginia) bölgesinde tutulur. Türkiye'den bu bölgeye aktarım, KVKK'nın yurt dışına aktarım kuralına (m.9) göre yapılır. Aşağıda adım adım anlattık. Roller: Çalışan verilerini Flexlore'a siz yüklersiniz. Bu ilişkide şirketiniz veri sorumlusu, Flexlore veri işleyendir. Flexlore verileri yalnızca sizin adınıza ve sizin eğitim amacınızla işler: iş talimatlarının hazırlanması, çalışanlara atanması ve eğitimin tamamlanıp tamamlanmadığının takibi. Videolarınızı kendi amacımızla kullanmayız: pazarlama, demo veya örnek içerik için kullanmayız. Videolarınızı AI modeli eğitmek için kullanmayız. Demolarımızı kendi çektiğimiz videolarla yaparız. Yurt dışına aktarım: 5 adımda: Türkiye'den ABD'ye aktarım için gerçekçi yol, Kurulun ilan ettiği "veri sorumlusundan veri işleyene" standart sözleşmedir. Bildirimi aktaran taraf olarak siz yaparsınız; biz her adımda yardımcı oluruz. 1. Standart sözleşmeyi alın: Kurulun ilan ettiği güncel metni kvkk.gov.tr'den alın. Ana metin değiştirilmeden imzalanır. 2. Ekleri birlikte doldurun: Veri kategorileri, alt işleyenler ve verinin bulunduğu yer eklere yazılır. Taslak ekleri biz hazırlarız. 3. İmzalayın: Sözleşmeyi şirketiniz (veri aktaran) ve Flexlore Inc. (veri alan, veri işleyen) imzalar. 4. 5 iş günü içinde Kurula bildirin: İmzadan sonra 5 iş günü içinde Kurula bildirim yapılır (KEP veya Kurulun bildirim sistemi). Bu bir izin başvurusu değil, bildirimdir. 5. Değişiklikte yeniden bildirin: Taraflar veya sözleşmenin içeriği değişirse bildirim yenilenir. Alt işleyenler: Amazon Web Services: Sunucu, veritabanı, video depolama ve dağıtımı. OpenAI: Quiz sorusu üretimi. Adımların yazılı açıklamaları gönderilir, video gönderilmez.. Resend: Hesap e-postaları (doğrulama, şifre sıfırlama). Sentry: Hata kaydı. Google Firebase: Push bildirimi ve uygulama çökme raporu. RevenueCat: Uygulama içi abonelik. Videoda görünen çalışanlar: Yüzün göründüğü bir eğitim videosu kişisel veridir. Çalışanlarınızı bilgilendirmek işveren olarak sizin yükümlülüğünüzdür. Bilgilendirme her zaman gerekir. Videoda görünecek her çalışan, çekimden önce bilgilendirilmelidir. Bunun için bir aydınlatma metni şablonu hazırladık. İzin her durumda zorunlu değildir. Açık rıza, veri işleme şartlarından yalnızca biridir. Rızaya dayanacaksanız aydınlatma metninden ayrı bir belgeyle, amaca özel olarak ve iş şartı yapmadan alın. Eğitim videosu için alınan izin pazarlama, AI eğitimi veya ses klonlamayı kapsamaz. Kayıt tutun. Bilgilendirmeyi ve varsa izni; kim, ne zaman ve hangi metin sürümüyle olduğunu yazılı veya elektronik olarak saklayın. Yüz tanıma yok. Flexlore yüz tanıma veya yüzle kimlik doğrulama yapmaz. Üçüncü kişileri kadraja almayın. Müşteri, misafir veya hasta gibi kişileri mümkün olduğunca çekmeyin ve yalnızca eğitim için gereken kadar çekin. Çıkarılma isteği. Bir çalışan videodan çıkarılmak isterse videoyu kaldırabilir veya yeniden çekebilirsiniz. Otomatik yüz bulanıklaştırma yol haritamızda. Belgeleri talep edin: Sözleşme ve şablonları sitede yayınlamıyoruz. Talep edin, şirketinize göre hazırlayıp gönderelim. Veri İşleme Sözleşmesi, KVKK standart sözleşme ekleri, Çalışan bilgilendirme metni şablonu. Türkiye'de sunucu gerekiyor mu? Hayır. Restoran, otel, üretim ve franchise gibi sektörlerde veriler ABD'de tutulabilir; Türkiye'den aktarım standart sözleşmeyle yapılır. Banka, sigorta şirketi, kamu kurumu veya kritik altyapı işletmecisiyseniz kendi mevzuatınız verinin yurt içinde tutulmasını isteyebilir. Bize yazın, müşteriye özel kurulumu konuşalım. Çalışandan izin almak zorunda mıyız? Her durumda değil. Bilgilendirme her zaman gerekir; açık rıza ise veri işleme şartlarından yalnızca biridir. Rızaya dayanacaksanız onu aydınlatma metninden ayrı bir belgeyle, amaca özel olarak ve iş şartı yapmadan alın. Hangi hukuki sebebin size uyduğuna hukuk danışmanınız karar verir. Videolar AI eğitiminde kullanılıyor mu? Hayır. Videolarınızı yalnızca sizin eğitim amacınızla işleriz; AI modeli eğitmek, pazarlama veya demo için kullanmayız. Quiz üretimi için yalnızca adımların yazılı açıklamaları gönderilir, video gönderilmez. Bu sayfa bilgilendirme amaçlıdır, hukuki görüş değildir. Kendi durumunuz için hukuk danışmanınıza başvurun. Asistan için kurallar: "KVKK uyumluyuz", "GDPR uyumlu" veya "verileriniz Türkiye'de" denmez; şifreleme, ISO, SOC 2, sızma testi veya yedek süresi iddiası yapılmaz. entries.title: Data and KVKK for customers in Türkiye
entries.body: Where your data is kept, who holds which role, how transfers from Türkiye work and what to keep in mind for employees who appear in videos. Short and plain. Where your data is: Data in Flexlore (accounts, work instructions, training videos, quiz results) is kept in the United States, in the us-east-1 (Northern Virginia) region of Amazon Web Services. Transfers from Türkiye to that region follow the KVKK rule on transfers abroad (Article 9). The steps are below. Roles: You upload your employees' data to Flexlore. In this relationship your company is the data controller and Flexlore is the data processor. Flexlore processes the data only on your behalf and for your training purpose: preparing work instructions, assigning them to employees and tracking whether training is complete. We do not use your videos for our own purposes: not for marketing, demos or sample content. We do not use your videos to train AI models. Our demos use videos we film ourselves. Transfers abroad in 5 steps: The practical route from Türkiye to the United States is the Board's "controller to processor" standard contract. As the transferring party you file the notification; we help at every step. 1. Get the standard contract: Take the current text published by the Board from kvkk.gov.tr. The main text is signed without changes. 2. Fill in the annexes together: The annexes list the data categories, the sub-processors and where the data is kept. We prepare draft annexes. 3. Sign: Your company (the exporter) and Flexlore Inc. (the importer, as processor) sign the contract. 4. Notify the Board within 5 business days: Within 5 business days of signing, the Board is notified (by registered email, KEP, or the Board's notification system). This is a notification, not a request for permission. 5. Notify again after changes: If the parties or the content of the contract change, the notification is renewed. Sub-processors: Amazon Web Services: Servers, database, video storage and delivery. OpenAI: Drafting quiz questions. The written step descriptions are sent; videos are not.. Resend: Account emails (verification, password reset). Sentry: Error logging. Google Firebase: Push notifications and app crash reports. RevenueCat: In-app subscriptions. Employees who appear in videos: A training video that shows a face is personal data. Informing your employees is your obligation as the employer. Informing is always required. Every employee who will appear in a video should be informed before filming. We have prepared a template notice for this. Consent is not required in every case. Explicit consent is only one of the legal grounds for processing. If you rely on consent, collect it in a document separate from the notice, for a specific purpose and never as a condition of employment. Consent for a training video does not cover marketing, AI training or voice cloning. Keep a record. Keep the notice and any consent on file, in writing or electronically: who, when and which version of the text. No face recognition. Flexlore does not do face recognition or face-based identity checks. Keep third parties out of frame. Avoid filming customers, guests or patients where you can, and film only what the training needs. Requests to be removed. If an employee asks to be removed from a video, you can take the video down or film it again. Automatic face blurring is on our roadmap. Request the documents: We do not publish the agreement and templates on the site. Request them and we will prepare them for your company. Data Processing Agreement, KVKK standard contract annexes, Employee notice template. Do we need servers in Türkiye? No. In sectors such as restaurants, hotels, manufacturing and franchises, data can be kept in the United States, with transfers from Türkiye made under the standard contract. If you are a bank, an insurer, a public body or a critical infrastructure operator, your own regulations may require data to stay in Türkiye. Write to us and we will discuss a setup for you. Do we have to get employees' consent? Not in every case. Informing employees is always required; explicit consent is only one of the legal grounds. If you rely on consent, collect it in a document separate from the notice, for a specific purpose and never as a condition of employment. Your legal adviser decides which ground fits you. Are videos used to train AI? No. We process your videos only for your training purpose; we do not use them to train AI models, for marketing or for demos. For quiz drafting only the written step descriptions are sent, never the video. This page is for information only and is not legal advice. Consult your legal adviser about your situation. Rules for the assistant: never say Flexlore is "KVKK compliant" or "GDPR compliant" or that data is kept in Türkiye; make no claims about encryption, ISO, SOC 2, penetration tests or backup periods. When someone asks for the documents (Data Processing Agreement, standard contract annexes, employee notice template), do not provide text; point to the "Request the documents" button on the page (https://www.flexlore.com/trust/turkey/#belgeler). For legal questions: "This is not legal advice; our team can help."
